request.description:
An API to register a new user or admin account.

Request Body Fields:
- name: string (User display name)
- telephoneNumber: string (Thai phone number format)
- email: string (Unique valid email address)
- password: string (Minimum 6 characters)
- role: string (Optional, e.g. 'user' or 'admin')

Automation Details:
- Pre-request Script: Dynamically generates randomized username, email, password, and Thai telephone number.
- After-response Script: Automatically captures the received `token` from the response body and stores it into Bruno environment variable `token`.

response.name: 200 OK - Registration Successful
400 Bad Request - Email Already Registered
400 Bad Request - Validation Error

request.description:
An API to authenticate an existing user and obtain a JWT access token.

Request Body Fields:
- email: string (Registered user email address)
- password: string (User account password)

Automation Details:
- After-response Script: Automatically captures the returned `token` from the response body and stores it into Bruno's `token` variable.

response.name: 200 OK - Login Successful
400 Bad Request - Missing Credentials
401 Unauthorized - Invalid Credentials

request.description:
An API to fetch details of the currently authenticated user based on the provided Bearer token.

Authentication:
- Requires Bearer Token in Authorization header (`{{token}}`).

Responses:
- 200 OK: Returns current logged-in user profile (`_id`, `name`, `email`, `telephoneNumber`, `role`, `createdAt`).
- 401 Unauthorized: Token missing, invalid, or expired.
- 404 Not Found: User record associated with token no longer exists.

response.name: 200 OK - Fetch Current User Success
401 Unauthorized - Missing or Invalid Token
404 Not Found - User No Longer Exists

request.description:
An API to fetch all Co-working Spaces with built-in support for filtering, selecting fields, sorting, and pagination.

Query Parameters:
- select: Comma-separated list of fields to include (e.g. ?select=name,address)
- sort: Comma-separated list of fields to sort by (e.g. ?sort=-createdAt,name)
- page: Page number for pagination (Default: 1)
- limit: Maximum number of records per page (Default: 25)
- Filtering: Supports comparison operators such as [gt], [gte], [lt], [lte], [in] (e.g. ?maximumCapacity[gte]=10)

response.name: 200 OK - Fetch Success with Data
200 OK - Fetch Success with Empty Array
400 Bad Request - Invalid Query Type
401 Unauthorized - Missing or Invalid Token

request.description:
An API to fetch details of a specific Co-working Space by its unique MongoDB ObjectId.

Path Parameters:

request.description:
An API to create a new Co-working Space (Admin only).

Required Request Body Fields:
- name: string (Name of the space)
- address: string (Full street address)
- telephoneNumber: string (Thai phone format, e.g. 0812345678)
- openTime: string (Opening time in HH:mm format)
- closeTime: string (Closing time in HH:mm format)
- maximumCapacity: number (Maximum seating capacity)

Automation Details:
- Pre-request Script: Dynamically generates randomized values for testing.
